bar.text: ...SMALL CRAFT ADVISORY IN EFFECT THROUGH THIS AFTERNOON... Combined seas 9 to 11 ft subsiding to 7 to 9 ft this evening. Bar conditions rough becoming moderate this evening. Maximum ebb currents will occur around 415 AM Sunday, 445 PM Sunday, and 500 AM Monday. The Sunday afternoon ebb will be very strong.
